description: A tool: a named process that declares its interface the way a method does.

inputs.description: Each input is its JSON Schema, required unless it says `optional: true`, as a method's are.

name.description: The catalog name a step's `tool:` uses.

outputs.description: Each output is its JSON Schema, as a method's are. One with a `packet` is also kept as an artifact of that packet.

result_as.description: The output the whole result becomes, as a step's `result_as` is.

title: ToolManifest
